provider_free_findings: The built staging Worker intercepts POST /api/v2/v207/generated-output-port and returns 404 V207_ROUTE_DISABLED without the signer while attaching x-videoforge-worker-version when CF_VERSION_METADATA is valid.

The production Worker does not compose the V2-07 port; its hosted fallback returns 503 HOSTED_ROUTE_NOT_COMPOSED with x-videoforge-runtime hosted-v2-06 and no x-videoforge-worker-version header, matching the later observed response.

Signer activation requires the exact active Worker version header, but waitForRefreshDisabledRoute and waitForRouteRestoration call readRouteFingerprint without requiring or comparing Worker version identity.

rollbackAndVerify proves the control-plane deployment record, while the cleanup route loop separately proves only status and error code; no invariant binds the two observations to one immutable Worker version.
Therefore sixteen matching disabled-route reads can be accepted even though a later edge serves the uncomposed V2-06 contract. Attempt53 cleanup cannot be qualified from the immediate 404 window.
exact_provider_free_repair_scope: After the signer-disabled refresh deploy, read and retain the exact active version before route acceptance.
Require x-videoforge-worker-version on every refresh-disabled and post-promotion route read and require equality with that exact refreshed version.
During refresh-mode cleanup, require every restored 404 V207_ROUTE_DISABLED read to carry the exact captured rollback-target version; missing, malformed, mixed, or changed identities fail closed.
Record only the version ID hash in durable evidence.
Add focused mixed-edge tests for status/code matches from missing, stale, and alternating version identities; preserve non-refresh historical fingerprint behavior.
